Come share your ideas and help shape the future of Newhall Park! 🌳✨ Join us to …explore design options and share your input on proposed improvements, including: 💦 New splash pad 🛝 Inclusive playground 🏃 Fitness equipment 📐 Potential layouts for these new spaces 📅 Thursday, September 10 ⏰ 6:00–8:00 p.m. 📍 Newhall Park Community Room (24923 Newhall Avenue) Your feedback will help guide the design of these new spaces! 📞 For more information, call Connor Hahm at (661) 255-4322 ----------------- ¡Ven a compartir tus ideas y ayúdanos a darle forma al futuro de Newhall Park! 🌳✨ Acompáñanos para conocer las opciones de diseño y compartir tu opinión sobre las mejoras propuestas: 💦 Nueva zona de juegos con agua 🛝 Área de juegos inclusiva 🏃 Aparatos para hacer ejercicio 📐 Distribución de estos nuevos espacios 📅 Jueves 10 de septiembre ⏰ 6:00–8:00 p.m. 📍 Salón Comunitario de Newhall Park (24923 Newhall Avenue) ¡Tus comentarios nos ayudarán a definir el diseño del proyecto! 📞 Para obtener más información, llama a Connor Hahm at (661) 255-4322 Para más contenido en español, sigue nuestras páginas en Facebook e Instagram @CiudadDeSantaClarita ❤

This Week in Santa Clarita... 🌿 Looking for a way to give back to your community? Join us …on Saturday, September 19, at the Newhall Community Center for the 31st Annual River Rally Clean-Up from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. Over the past 30 years, volunteers have removed more than 510,000 pounds of trash from the Santa Clara River! This year, you can be part of the effort and help keep one of Southern California’s last natural, free-flowing river systems clean. And once the clean-up wraps up, don’t forget to check out the Environmental Expo! Sign up today at GreenSantaClarita.com. #santaclarita #staygreen #community #cleanup #riverrally

We made it a good day on the Beach Bus this past weekend with our third and final Beach …Ball Giveaway, but summer isn’t over just yet! 🏖️🚌😎 The Beach Bus is hitting the road one final time this Labor Day weekend. ☀️ Catch some waves and let us do the driving! 🌊🚌 Learn more at SantaClaritaTransit.com/Beach-Bus/. - ¡Así se disfruta el verano! ☀️🌊 Este fin de semana vivimos un gran día a bordo del Beach Bus con nuestra tercera y última entrega de pelotas de playa. 🏖️🚌😎 Y aunque las entregas llegaron a su fin, todavía queda una última oportunidad para disfrutar del Beach Bus. 🚌 Este fin de semana de Labor Day, súbete al Beach Bus en su último recorrido de la temporada. Tú disfruta de la playa y las olas; nosotros te llevamos. 🌊☀️ Conoce todos los detalles en SantaClaritaTransit.com/Beach-Bus/. #SantaClaritaTransit #BeachBus #SantaClarita

This Week in Santa Clarita… Got Library fines? Turn them into an opportunity to give back! …📚❤️ This September, bring non-perishable food items or toiletries to any Santa Clarita Public Library branch and receive a $5 credit toward eligible Library fees for each item donated, up to $20.� Your donations will help support local organizations, including The Salvation Army, Santa Clarita Valley Food Pantry and Santa Clarita Grocery. 🥫🧴� Clear your fines. Give back. Help feed your community.� 📅 Food For Fines runs throughout September at all three Library branches.� Learn more at Library.SantaClarita.gov!� This Week in Santa Clarita (TWISC) highlights the City’s latest projects, programs and events through weekly updates from City staff.� #TWISC #FoodForFines #GiveBack #SantaClaritaLibrary #SantaClarita
